title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Senior Staff Frontend Engineer, Admin Experience**
====================================================

Zendesk is transforming the way businesses build meaningful customer relationships. Our products help organizations deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences at scale, and our Admin Experience is central to how customers configure, manage, and get value from the Zendesk platform.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Frontend Engineer to help bring Zendesk’s Admin Experience vision to life for an AI-first future. This is a high-impact technical leadership role for someone who combines deep frontend expertise with product thinking, system design, and strong cross-functional leadership.

In this role, you will strengthen and operationalize our vision by translating high-level concepts into technically sound, scalable, and actionable frontend strategies. You will work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to reimagine complex user journeys and deliver intuitive, intelligent, and cohesive experiences for Zendesk admins.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Translate the Admin Experience vision into a clear end-to-end strategy focused on the frontend, architecture, roadmap, and execution plan.
* Lead major initiatives across teams and product areas while remaining hands-on with writing code.
* Partner with Product and Design to deliver intuitive, scalable, and cohesive experiences for Zendesk admins.
* Establish reusable frontend patterns, components, and platform capabilities that improve consistency and accelerate delivery.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs while balancing near-term priorities with long-term maintainability.
* Advance performance, accessibility, reliability, testing, observability, and developer experience.
* Build and maintain scalable, unified CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Spinnaker) for Admin Experience and Agent Workspace to improve delivery speed and reliability.
* Drive developer productivity by optimizing build systems, testing infrastructure (PlayWright), and local development tooling.
* Mentor engineers and raise the engineering bar through technical guidance, design reviews, and 1-1 coaching.

**What You Bring to the Role**
------------------------------

* 15+ years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in frontend product development.
* Proven success delivering complex, enterprise-scale UI initiatives.
* Strong proficiency in Javascript or TypeScript, React, modern web standards, GraphQL, API integration, and frontend architecture.
* Deep knowledge of frontend best practices, including accessibility, performance, testing, and reliability.
* Ability to translate ambiguous product goals into pragmatic execution plans.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives from discovery through to delivery
* Ability to influence without direct authority, align teams, and communicate effectively with senior leaders.
* Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience leading major transformations or redesigns of existing user experiences, particularly to make them AI-first.
* Experience building enterprise SaaS products, configuration tools, or complex operational experiences.
Familiarity with AI interaction patterns, including agents, recommendations, automation, conversational interfaces, and human-in-the-loop workflows.  

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.

Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.

**The intelligent heart of customer experience**

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.

Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here .

Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e-mail to peopleandplaces@zendesk.com with your specific accommodation request.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**

  

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you're blocked.

We're here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we've built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we're going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc's marketplace topower access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from *seeking* to *getting*. We don't want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

**Your Impact on Our Mission**

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to join the teams that build Zocdoc's provider platform — Provider Infrastructure and Provider Roster Management.

These teams create and scale the core systems that:

* Store and serve provider, location, and roster data as a reliable source of truth.
* Power onboarding and ongoing management experiences for practices of all sizes, from solo providers to large health systems.
* Ensure provider changes propagate quickly and safely to downstream systems like Search, Availability, Analytics, and Integrations — so patients always see accurate information.

We're building toward a future where Zocdoc can onboard and manage tens of thousands of providers under a single organisation in days, not months, with predictable performance and reliability across the stack. Your work will directly improve how quickly providers get live on Zocdoc, how confidently clients manage their rosters, and how reliably downstream experiences behave as we scale.

As a senior engineer here, you'll balance meaningful individual contribution with mentorship. You'll work across the stack — front to back and everything in between — with an emphasis on robust, observable services and high-scale data flows. You'll take ideas from inception to reality by rapidly iterating, validating with real usage, and hardening systems for long-term scale.

**You'll Enjoy This Role If You Are…**

* Excited by the challenge of scaling — passionate about building reliable systems with cloud-native infrastructure and event-driven patterns.
* A product-driven engineer who enjoys partnering closely with PM, design, Ops, and analytics to solve real customer problems.
* Motivated by building products that make healthcare easier for providers, operations teams, and patients.
* Excited to use technology to simplify complex workflows — turning messy, high-volume data into clear, predictable experiences.
* Passionate about building diverse and inclusive teams and culture.
* Curious about how AI and GenAI can responsibly improve developer productivity and provider experiences (e.g., smarter prefill, better insights), while staying grounded in real value.

**Your Day to Day Is…**

* Building and evolving services and tools that power our scaling initiatives across Provider Infrastructure and Roster Management.
* Writing clean, well-tested code across C#, React, and AWS-based services.
* Collaborating closely with engineers, PMs, designers, and Ops to shape solutions from idea to launch.
* Contributing to service migrations away from legacy systems toward modern, event-driven architectures.
* Using metrics, dashboards, and load tests to keep services healthy and observable as usage grows.
* Sharing knowledge and feedback to help the team move faster and make better technical decisions.

*Note: As a Zocdoc engineer, you'll have access to and be encouraged to use generative AI coding tools as part of your day-to-day workflow.*

**You'll Be Successful in This Role If You Have…**

* 6+ years of professional software development experience, with significant backend or full-stack work on distributed systems.
* Experience shipping features or services for high-scale systems — internal tools, data pipelines, or user-facing applications — where correctness, resilience, and performance matter.
* Comfort working across the stack and learning unfamiliar parts of a system when needed.
* Experience in an agile, cross-functional environment, collaborating with product, design, analytics, and operations partners.
* A track record of mentoring other engineers and raising the bar on testing, observability, and deployment practices.
* Solid communication skills and empathy for both internal users and external customers.

**Technologies we use**

* C# and .NET
* React
* AWS — DynamoDB, Lambda, SQS/SNS, Kinesis
* Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, asynchronous event processing
* AI/ML and GenAI tooling (e.g., LLM-based services, vector search, embeddings)

**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Flexible, hybrid work environment
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare reimbursement
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Sponsored counselling and therapy via Betterlyf
* Competitive PTO
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2022-2026

**About us**  
Zocdoc is the country's leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc's Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world's leading investors, and we believe we're still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

  

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - *Together, Not Alone*, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We're an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

title: Senior DBT Developer
description:
### **Job Title:** **Senior DBT Engineer**

**Experience Level:** 8–10 Years

#### **About the Role:**

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior dBT Engineer to design, build, and optimize our cloud-based data architecture. In this role, you will be responsible for building highly scalable data pipelines, optimizing data warehouse performance, and ensuring the highest standards of data quality. The ideal candidate will have 8 to 10 years of deep technical experience in databases, data warehousing, and modern cloud data stacks (AWS, dbt, PySpark).

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Data Modeling & Transformation (dbt):** Design and maintain clean, scalable data models. Write custom macros and implement automated testing to ensure data integrity before it moves upstream.
* **Big Data Processing (PySpark):** Write highly efficient, production-grade PySpark code to process massive datasets, clean messy data, and prepare it for enterprise storage.
* **Data Warehousing (AWS Redshift):** Architect, build, and maintain Redshift table structures. Actively monitor and tune database performance to ensure blazing-fast query execution.
* **Cloud Data Infrastructure:** Leverage core AWS services to build end-to-end data solutions, utilizing S3 (file storage), AWS Glue (data cataloging/ETL), Lambda (automation scripts), and Step Functions (workflow orchestration).
* **Pipeline Development:** Develop robust pre-integration processes to extract raw data from various APIs and third-party sources into staging areas.
* **Data Quality & CI/CD:** Build automated systems to catch errors and bad data early in the pipeline. Manage code deployments, version control, and collaboration using Git.

#### **Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** 8–10 years of proven, hands-on experience working with enterprise databases and data warehousing technologies.
* **Data Warehousing Fundamentals:** Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of key data warehousing concepts, including Facts, Dimensions, Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD1, SCD2), Data Loads, and Transformations.
* **Python & SQL Mastery:**

  + Must be a highly proficient Python coder capable of using libraries like pandas and boto3 to build scripts and connect to complex APIs.
  + Ability to write, debug, and optimize advanced SQL queries with ease.
* **Cloud Expertise:** Solid, hands-on experience operating within the AWS ecosystem (Redshift, S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions).
* **Big Data Tools:** Strong background in Apache Spark/PySpark for large-scale data transformations.
* **Modern Data Stack:** Practical experience with dbt (data build tool) for data transformation and testing.

title: Principal Software Engineer (AI Prism)
description:

This role will own translating complex AI capabilities into developing scalable, production-grade solutions that drive real business impact. You are the technical owner of the platform's core infrastructure — including AI standard protocols and the AI services layer. title: Staff Engineer Software - AUTOSAR MCAL
description:
**About GlobalFoundries**

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com .

  
  

MIPS by GlobalFoundries company is a microprocessor pioneer with deep roots in RISC-based computing. Today, MIPS is building RISC-V processor solutions for high-performance and embedded applications, combining CPU architecture expertise with platform software, tools, and ecosystem enablement.

  

**Join the RISC-V Revolution at MIPS!**

  

**Introduction:**

We are looking for hands-on embedded software engineers to develop AUTOSAR-compliant MCAL components for next-generation MIPS RISC-V automotive real-time MCUs. You will work across driver development, hardware bring-up, safety-compliant engineering, integration, and validation for applications including ADAS, powertrain, body electronics, and domain controllers.

  
  

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and maintain AUTOSAR MCAL drivers for peripherals such as ADC, PWM, GPT, ICU, DIO, PORT, CAN, LIN, SPI, UART, WDG, MCU, FLS, and Ethernet.

* Own assigned MCAL modules across requirements analysis, design, coding, configuration, unit testing, integration, and validation.

* Implement software in compliance with MISRA C and AUTOSAR coding guidelines, and resolve findings from static-analysis tools.

* Create software design descriptions, configuration guidance, test specifications, traceability, and other required engineering work products.

* Bring up and debug MCAL drivers on FPGA and silicon using Lauterbach, iSystem, or similar embedded debug tools.

* Collaborate with SoC architecture, hardware, platform software, functional safety, validation, and tools teams on clocks, resets, interrupts, DMA, memory maps, and peripheral integration.

* Integrate MCAL components with AUTOSAR BSW stacks and configuration environments, and support system-level issue resolution.

* Develop automated unit, integration, and regression tests and contribute to CI-based quality checks.

Participate in code reviews, design reviews, defect analysis, and continuous improvement of reusable MCAL components.  

  

**What You Should Have**

* 4-6 years of embedded software development experience, including meaningful hands-on AUTOSAR MCAL or low-level driver development.

* Strong embedded C programming skills and practical knowledge of pointers, memory-mapped I/O, interrupts, concurrency, and linker or startup concepts.

* Experience developing or integrating MCAL modules and working with AUTOSAR specifications and configuration workflows.

* Good understanding of MCU subsystems including clocks, resets, interrupt controllers, DMA, timers, watchdogs, communication peripherals, and memory interfaces.

* Experience with MISRA C, static analysis, code reviews, unit testing, and requirements-to-test traceability.

* Working knowledge of ISO 26262 software development practices and safety-oriented engineering deliverables.

* Experience with hardware bring-up and debugging using Lauterbach, iSystem, J-Link, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or similar equipment.

* Experience with Git and scripting in Python or shell for build and test automation.

Ability to read hardware specifications and translate register-level behavior into reliable production-quality drivers.  

  

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on use of EB tresos Studio, Vector DaVinci Configurator, or equivalent AUTOSAR configuration tools.

* Experience with Vector, Elektrobit, ETAS, or another third-party AUTOSAR BSW stack.

* Exposure to tools such as Polyspace, QAC, Tessy, Cantata, or equivalent static-analysis and unit-test solutions.

* Knowledge of RISC-V architecture or experience moving MCAL software across MCU architectures.

* Exposure to ASPICE, safety audits, tool qualification, customer delivery, or OEM/Tier-1 integration.

Experience with automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet, and SPI.  

  

**What You'll Get**

* Opportunity to build MCAL software for a new RISC-V automotive MCU platform.

* Direct collaboration with CPU, SoC, functional safety, validation, and platform software teams.

* End-to-end ownership from specification and driver implementation through hardware validation and customer enablement.

A flexible growth path toward MCAL architecture, functional safety, platform leadership, or deep technical specialization.  

  
  

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard.

As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities.

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

title: Lead Enterprise Software Engineer
description:
Wolters Kluwer is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Lead ITSM Engineer – Operations & Governance to join our IT Service Management Office (ITSMO). This is an exciting opportunity for an individual with deep, hands-on experience governing IT Service Management at enterprise scale to take ownership of how our ITSM operating model works in practice, and to make a meaningful impact within a forward-thinking organization.

As a Lead ITSM Engineer, you will play a crucial role in leading the day-to-day operation and governance of the full set of ITSM practices — Change Enablement, Incident Management, Service Request Management, Problem Management, Service Level Management and Availability Management — ensuring that the processes defined by our Outcome Owners are consistently executed, measured, controlled and genuinely embedded within our technology teams.

In this role, you will be responsible for working closely with a broad set of stakeholders, including Outcome Owners, Service Delivery and IT Operations teams, DevSecOps, Cloud Operations, Security, Compliance, vendors and senior leadership. You will act as the primary operational interface between the Outcome Owners who define our capabilities and the teams who execute them every day. Your primary focus will be on running the governance forums, control framework, performance reporting and assurance activities that give leadership confidence that our services are being managed effectively across every practice, not just during disruption.

You will be involved in a wide range of activities, including change governance and CAB or ECAB operation, request fulfilment performance and catalogue governance, incident and problem governance, SLA and SLO reporting, ITSM tooling and workflow operation, and the engineering of automation and AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort and process variation. Your command of ITIL, the IT4IT reference architecture and modern service reliability practice will be critical as you coordinate process execution across technology teams and translate operational data into decisions leadership can act on.

As a Lead ITSM Engineer, you will be expected to drive accountability across teams that do not report to you, challenge constructively where standards are not being met, and build consensus on how practices should operate. You will own the ITSM improvement portfolio end to end and lead complex initiatives from concept through implementation and measurement. Your ability to communicate process performance, control effectiveness and service risk in clear business terms will be essential.

Importantly, this role governs how capabilities are operated, measured and assured; it does not own their definition or strategic direction, which remains with the relevant Outcome Owner. Success in this position means making that boundary work in practice and feeding systemic process weaknesses back to Outcome Owners in a structured, evidence-based way.

This position offers a fantastic opportunity for growth and career development within a supportive and innovative environment. You will work with state-of-the-art technologies, be part of a collaborative and high-performing team, and make a significant impact on our organization's success. If you are passionate about service management engineering and eager to take your career to the next level, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Wolters Kluwer.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

ITSM Practice Governance

* Lead the operational governance of all ITSM practices across the ITSM Office, including Change Enablement, Incident Management, Service Request Management, Problem Management, Service Level Management, Availability Management and event notification.
* Run the ITSM governance forums, cadence and decision-making that keep the operating model functioning, and ensure decisions are recorded, communicated and followed through.
* Govern Change Enablement performance: change success and failure rates, emergency and unauthorised change levels, risk assessment quality, approval effectiveness, and CAB and ECAB operation and discipline.
* Govern Service Request Management: catalogue accuracy and coverage, fulfilment performance against target, approval routing, automation coverage and request-to-incident leakage.
* Govern Incident Management as a practice: categorisation and priority accuracy, assignment and routing quality, resolution performance, reopen rates and the quality of incident records.
* Govern Problem Management: proactive problem identification, root-cause analysis quality, known-error management, and ownership, due dates and evidenced closure of corrective actions.
* Coordinate consistent execution of ITSM processes across technology, DevSecOps and Service Delivery teams, and govern adherence to Outcome Owner-defined processes, standards and controls.
* Coordinate SLA and SLO performance reporting and monitor process and service performance against agreed targets across all practices.

Assurance, Risk and Control

* Lead operational assurance activities, including process compliance reviews, control effectiveness testing and evidence collection.
* Support audits and operational control reviews and drive remediation of assurance findings, risks and exceptions to closure.
* Clarify accountability and escalation paths across practices and manage operational escalations.
* Identify systemic process execution issues and capability design weaknesses and provide structured operational feedback to Outcome Owners.

Operational Intelligence and Reporting

* Produce management and executive reporting that connects change, incident, request, problem, configuration, service-level and availability data to business impact and prioritized action.
* Build and govern trusted ITSM dashboards and analysis, ensuring data quality and consistent definitions across practices.
* Analyze cross-practice trends and risk patterns, such as the relationship between change activity and incident volume, and drive corrective improvement.

Automation, AI and Continual Improvement

* Own the ITSM improvement portfolio: prioritize, sequence and drive improvement actions across practices to measurable completion.
* Apply Lean methods, automation, AI agents and human-in-the-loop controls to reduce friction, manual effort, cycle time and process variation across ITSM value streams.
* Design and implement responsible AI and automation workflows across ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, xMatters, Power BI, DevSecOps and observability platforms, with clear value cases, validation, guardrails, auditability and outcome measures.
* Coordinate ITSM tooling and workflow operation, including platform configuration standards, workflow changes and release of process tooling.
* Establish baselines, targets and benefits-realization plans that demonstrate improvements in reliability, quality, speed and efficiency.
* Lead complex initiatives, owning requirements, plans, risks, dependencies, adoption and measurement.

Major Incident and Escalation

* Act as Incident Commander for high-severity incidents when required: mobilize resolver teams, manage decisions and escalations, and deliver timely stakeholder and executive communications.
* Govern the post-incident review process and ensure findings translate into durable corrective actions with evidenced closure.

General

* Communicate technical concepts, process performance and service risk to non-technical and executive stakeholders.
* Document processes, procedures, governance decisions and operational runbooks.
* Stay up to date with emerging ITSM, SRE and AI technologies and industry trends, and continuously improve systems, processes and methodologies.

**OTHER DUTIES**

* Performs other duties as assigned by management.
* Participates in a 24x7x365 on-call rotation with the Service Delivery and Operations team and serves as Escalation Manager when assigned.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Minimum of 8 years supporting IT operations or IT Service Management in a large, complex enterprise, including 5+ years across cloud, infrastructure, network, application or platform operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading ITSM governance at scale across multiple practices, including running governance forums, CAB or ECAB, performance reviews and operational assurance activities.
* Proven expertise in Change Enablement governance, including change risk assessment, approval models, emergency change control and change-related incident reduction.
* Proven expertise in Incident, Service Request and Problem Management governance, including root-cause analysis and corrective-action governance.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL, ITSM practices and the IT4IT reference architecture, covering Change Enablement, Incident Management, Service Request Management, Problem Management, Availability Management, Service Level Management and Continual Improvement.
* **ITIL Foundation and ITIL Managing Professional (MP) certification is a must.**
* Proven success redesigning process execution and delivering measurable improvements through automation, AI, analytics or workflow orchestration.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow across multiple modules and with Power BI, including workflow configuration and the design of trusted operational dashboards.
* Experience with DevOps or DevSecOps practices and solution development using Python, PowerShell, APIs, low-code tools or comparable technologies.
* Minimum 1 year of experience designing or implementing AI agents, generative AI solutions, specification-driven development or comparable capabilities.
* Strong analytical capability in KPI design, trend analysis, data storytelling and translating insight into prioritized action.
* Experience with incident alerting platforms such as xMatters or PagerDuty is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to Azure and AWS operational environments is preferred.

**Thought Leadership and Soft Skills:**

* Executive presence and the ability to communicate process performance, control effectiveness, service risk and recommendations in clear business terms to senior leadership.
* Ability to influence and drive accountability across teams without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to lead under pressure, challenge constructively, build consensus and manage competing priorities independently.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a genuine commitment to team success and continuous learning.

**Our Interview Practices**
---------------------------

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer
description:
Wolters Kluwer is seeking a motivated and talented Senior ITSM Engineer – Operations & Governance to join our dynamic IT Service Management Office (ITSMO). This is an exciting opportunity for an individual with hands-on experience in mature IT operations and service management to further develop their skills and make a meaningful impact within a forward-thinking organization.
  
As a Senior ITSM Engineer, you will play a crucial role in providing expert operational oversight across our ITSM practices — Change Enablement, Incident Management, Service Request Management, Problem Management, Service Level Management and Availability Management — ensuring that the processes and controls established by our Outcome Owners are consistently applied and are delivering their intended outcomes.

In this role, you will be responsible for working closely with various stakeholders, including our experienced operations and engineering teams, DevSecOps, Cloud Operations, Security, Compliance and other key partners. Your primary focus will be on operational assurance and performance management,monitoring how each practice is actually performing, reviewing change records and request fulfilment for quality and compliance, investigating recurring execution issues, facilitating performance reviews and coordinating practical improvements to the way ITSM is operated day to day.  
You will be involved in a wide range of tasks, including assuring change quality and approval compliance, monitoring request and incident performance against target, supporting problem management and post-incident review, conducting control and compliance reviews, and building the dashboards and analysis that make service performance visible.
  
You will gain hands-on experience with a variety of service management and automation technologies, including ServiceNow, Power BI, xMatters and AI-enabled workflow tooling, and your foundational understanding of ITIL and IT4IT concepts will be critical as you contribute to the implementation of best practices.

As a Senior ITSM Engineer, you will act as a senior operational advisor to technology teams, providing guidance on process adoption and validating that practices are being followed in reality rather than on paper. Where a process, control or capability design appears to be the underlying problem, you will provide structured, evidence-based feedback to the relevant Outcome Owner rather than working around it. Your attention to detail, analytical rigor and ability to communicate clearly will be essential to the successful delivery of reliable services.

This position offers a fantastic opportunity for growth and career development within a supportive and innovative environment. You will have the chance to work with state-of-the-art technologies, be part of a collaborative and high-performing team, and make a significant impact on our organization's success. If you are passionate about service reliability and eager to take your career to the next level, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Wolters Kluwer.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

ITSM Practice Assurance and Performance

* Monitor process performance across all ITSM practices — Change Enablement, Incident Management, Service Request Management, Problem Management, Service Level Management and Availability Management — and report on execution quality against defined standards.
* Assure Change Enablement execution: review change records for risk assessment quality, approval compliance, testing and back-out evidence, and analyse emergency, unauthorised and failed changes.
* Assure Service Request Management execution: monitor fulfilment performance against target, catalogue accuracy, approval routing and automation coverage, and identify requests being raised as incidents.
* Assure Incident Management execution: review categorisation and priority accuracy, assignment and routing quality, record completeness, reopen rates and resolution performance.
* Support Problem Management through post-incident reviews, root-cause analysis and tracking of corrective actions to evidenced closure.
* Monitor SLA, SLO and KPI performance across practices and escalate deviations with supporting analysis.
* Facilitate process and service performance reviews with technology teams and operational stakeholders.

Compliance, Control and Improvement

* Conduct operational assurance and compliance reviews, assessing process adoption and control effectiveness across technology and DevSecOps teams.
* Analyze trends, exceptions and recurring issues across change, incident, request, problem and availability data to identify risk patterns.
* Coordinate remediation actions arising from assurance findings, audits and performance reviews.
* Identify operational improvement opportunities and lead their implementation within agreed scope.
* Escalate process design and capability deficiencies to Outcome Owners with structured supporting evidence.
* Support audits and operational control reviews and maintain governance documentation.

Reporting and Automation

* Build and maintain trusted ITSM reporting and dashboards that connect operational data across practices to business impact.
* Develop scripts, automations and AI-enabled workflows across ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, xMatters, Power BI and observability platforms to reduce manual effort, with appropriate validation and guardrails.
* Improve the quality and consistency of ITSM data used for governance and reporting.

Governance Support and Operations

* Support ITSM governance forums, including CAB and ECAB, with preparation, analysis, actions and follow-up.
* Provide practical guidance to operational teams on process adoption, policy and controls.
* Support major incident response, including resolver-team engagement, stakeholder updates and post-incident data capture.
* Document processes, procedures and operational runbooks.
* Communicate technical concepts, process performance and service risk clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends and continuously improve systems, processes and methodologies.

OTHER DUTIES

* Performs other duties as assigned by management.
* Participates in a 24x7x365 on-call rotation with the Service Delivery and Operations team.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Minimum of 5 years supporting IT operations or IT Service Management in a large, complex enterprise, including 3+ years across cloud, infrastructure, network, application or platform operations.
* Demonstrated experience assuring or operating multiple ITSM practices, including Change Enablement, Incident Management, Service Request Management and Problem Management.
* Practical understanding of change risk assessment, approval models and change governance in a regulated or audited environment.
* Solid working knowledge of ITIL and ITSM practices, with familiarity with the IT4IT reference architecture,
* **ITIL Foundation certification is must.**
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, including reporting, workflow configuration and operational data quality.
* Proficiency with Power BI or comparable analytics tooling for building operational dashboards and performance reporting.
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell or Bash for automation tasks, and experience working with APIs or low-code tools.
* Exposure to AI or generative AI technologies applied to operational workflows, or a demonstrated willingness to develop this capability.
* Strong analytical capability in KPI design, trend analysis and data storytelling.
* Familiarity with DevOps or DevSecOps practices and with Azure and AWS operational environments.
* Exposure to incident alerting platforms such as xMatters or PagerDuty is helpful.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Thought Leadership and Soft Skills:

* Ability to communicate process performance, compliance findings and service risk in clear business terms to a range of stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge constructively when standards are not being met, and to work calmly under pressure during high-severity events.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to learn and contribute to team success.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS

* Improved change quality, approval compliance and reduction in failed, emergency and unauthorised changes.
* Improved request fulfilment performance, catalogue accuracy and automation coverage.
* Improved incident record quality, routing accuracy and resolution performance.
* Fewer recurring incidents and timely completion of corrective and remediation actions.
* Increased automation adoption, with measurable reductions in manual effort and process variation.
* Improved accuracy, adoption and business relevance of operational reporting and analytics.
* Stronger process adoption, control effectiveness and resolution of assurance findings.
* Documented improvements in service reliability and operational maturity.

**Our Interview Practices**
---------------------------

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We are seeking a **Lead/Senior Security System Engineer** to design, implement, and operate secure, compliant network segmentation between regional environments and Global networks, using a standardised control stack of Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Cloudflare for DDoS mitigation, WAF, and application protection. This role blends architecture, hands-on engineering, automation, and L3/L4 operational leadership to deliver policy-driven connectivity under strict regulatory and operational requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Define trust zones, routing boundaries, and inter-zone controls for regional and Global Network, covering north-south and east-west paths, micro-segmentation for sensitive tiers, and explicit cross-border allow-lists
* Produce HLD/LLD, threat models, and control mappings aligned to internal standards and regional regulation to enable secure communication
* Design and operate dual-vendor firewall perimeters, with clear control allocation, HA/cluster design, deterministic failover, NAT domain strategy, and SSL/TLS inspection governance tuned for jurisdiction
* Engineer ZIA for identity-aware egress controls, SSL inspection with jurisdiction-aware bypasses, inline CASB/DLP, and sanctioned SaaS governance
* Implement ZPA for per-application zero-trust access, with connector placement, posture checks, conditional access, and app segmentation replacing legacy VPN where feasible
* Design and deliver Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect/Partner Interconnect equivalents, and dual-tunnel HA per site with BGP for failover between on-prem and hub VPC
* Deploy Cloudflare Magic Transit/Magic WAN, WAF Management, and rate limiting for internet-facing services, with layered defence integration with on-prem perimeters
* Engineer SD-WAN/MPLS/SASE paths with policy-based routing, strong encryption, and defined key custody/rotation by jurisdiction
* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified
* Manage firewall, Zscaler, and Cloudflare policy through automation tools and vendor APIs, with CI/CD implementation including policy linting, unit tests, and path simulation

**Requirements**

* 6-15 years of overall IT experience, with a strong background in network security architecture and engineering
* Expertise in Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, and firewall cluster/HA design
* Proficiency in Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access for zero-trust and identity-aware access control
* Knowledge of Cloudflare Magic Transit, Magic WAN, and WAF for DDoS mitigation and application protection
* Familiarity with cloud hybrid connectivity, including Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect, and BGP routing
* Understanding of SD-WAN, MPLS, and SASE architectures with policy-based routing and strong encryption protocols
* Skills in Microsoft Sentinel and SIEM platforms for telemetry normalisation, detection engineering, and incident response
* Competency in automation and policy-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, and vendor REST APIs
* Qualifications in regulatory compliance and audit readiness, including control matrices and CIS Benchmarks

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development

  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits

Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary. Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.

**Role Overview**

As an SDE 2 | Python Developer, you will design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and RESTful APIs that power critical business applications. Your work will directly contribute to delivering reliable, high-performance software solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve product quality, engineering efficiency, and user experience.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Design, develop, test, and deploy backend applications and services using Python.
* Build and maintain RESTful APIs using Flask and/or Django frameworks.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Ensure application reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability across the software lifecycle.
* Work with databases, third-party integrations, and internal services to deliver robust system functionality.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes, tooling, and engineering standards.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 4-8 years of professional experience in Python backend development
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs
* Strong experience with Flask and/or Django frameworks
* Solid understanding of software development best practices and debugging
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams

**Preferred**

* Experience with scalable, high-performance backend systems
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and deployment workflows
* Exposure to microservices architecture
* Experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines

**What do we offer?**

**Growth**

At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we're seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us.

We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers.

**Learning Wallet:** Enrol in external courses or certifications to upskill—we'll reimburse the costs to support your development.

**Culture**

We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections.

* Regular community engagement and team-building activities
* Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture

**Wellness**

Your well-being is our priority. Comprehensive Mediclaim policy for you, your spouse, children, and parents.

**Work Environment**

We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.

Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
WritingJob Description: Senior Software Engineer / Staff Software EngineerAbout the Role

We are seeking an experienced and technically strong Senior Software Engineer / Staff Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance SaaS applications. The role involves leading backend development, designing distributed systems, making architecture decisions, and solving complex engineering challenges to improve product reliability and scalability.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in backend engineering, system design, microservices, and cloud infrastructure. This role also requires technical leadership, mentoring engineers, establishing engineering best practices, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* **Software Architecture and Design:** Design scalable, secure, and maintainable software architectures that support business requirements and long-term product growth.
* **Backend Development:** Lead the development of robust backend services and applications using Java, Python, Go, or other suitable programming languages.
* **Distributed Systems:** Design, build, and maintain distributed systems and microservices to support high availability, scalability, and fault tolerance.
* **System Design:** Develop architectural solutions, evaluate technical trade-offs, and establish design patterns for complex software systems.
* **API Development:** Design and implement efficient, secure, and scalable APIs to support seamless communication between services and applications.
* **Database Optimization:** Work with SQL and NoSQL databases, caching mechanisms, and data storage systems to improve query performance and application efficiency.
* **Performance Optimization:** Identify performance bottlenecks, conduct root cause analysis, and implement improvements to reduce latency and increase system throughput.
* **Cloud Infrastructure:** Develop and maintain cloud-based infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and scalable application environments.
* **CI/CD and Automation:** Improve continuous integration and continuous deployment processes to enable reliable releases and efficient engineering workflows.
* **System Reliability and Observability:** Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting solutions to improve system visibility, availability, and incident response.
* **Code Quality and Reviews:** Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews, and promote testing practices and maintainable software development.
* **Technical Mentoring:** Mentor engineers, provide technical guidance, and support team members in solving complex engineering problems.
* **Technical Decision-Making:** Lead architecture discussions, evaluate technologies, and make informed engineering decisions aligned with product and business goals.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with product management, security, infrastructure, QA, and other engineering teams to deliver reliable software solutions.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to improve development processes, system architecture, engineering productivity, and overall product quality.

Qualifications and Experience

* **Educational Qualification:** Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

description:

**Company:** SHM Group of Companies

The ERP Odoo Functional Consultant will be responsible for understanding business requirements across SHM Group's various business verticals and translating them into effective ERP solutions using Odoo. The role involves ERP implementation, configuration, business process mapping, user training, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and continuous system improvement to ensure seamless integration of business operations.

**A. Business Process Analysis and Requirement Gathering**

* Understand existing business processes across departments and business verticals.
* Conduct discussions with stakeholders to identify operational requirements, process gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and process flow diagrams.
* Map existing workflows to standard Odoo functionalities and recommend suitable solutions.
* Identify opportunities for process automation, standardisation, and improved internal controls.

**B. Odoo ERP Implementation and Configuration**

* Configure and implement Odoo modules based on approved business requirements.
* Work on modules such as:
* Sales and CRM
* Purchase and Vendor Management
* Inventory and Warehouse Management
* Manufacturing and Production
* Accounting and Finance
* HR, Employee Management, and Recruitment
* Project Management and Timesheets
* Maintenance and Quality, wherever applicable
* Configure user roles, access rights, approval workflows, automated activities, and business rules.
* Support integration between different Odoo modules and ensure smooth end-to-end transaction flows.
* Assist in implementing standardised processes across SHM Group companies and branches.

**C. Functional Design and Technical Coordination**

* Translate functional requirements into clear specifications for the Odoo development team.
* Coordinate with developers for customisation, reports, dashboards, integrations, and additional functionalities.
* Evaluate whether requirements can be addressed through standard Odoo features, configuration, or custom development.
* Review customised solutions to ensure alignment with business requirements.
* Support API and third-party application integration from a functional perspective.

**D. Testing and Quality Assurance**

* Prepare test scenarios, test cases, and user acceptance testing (UAT) plans.
* Conduct functional testing, integration testing, and regression testing.
* Coordinate with end users to validate system functionality before deployment.
* Identify, document, and track defects until resolution.
* Ensure that changes are tested and approved before being moved into the production environment.

**E. Data Migration and Master Data Management**

* Support data cleansing, validation, mapping, and migration from existing systems or Excel files into Odoo.

**G. ERP Support and Continuous Improvement**

* Provide functional support for day-to-day Odoo issues and troubleshoot transaction or workflow-related problems.
* Analyse recurring issues and coordinate with the technical team for permanent resolution.
* Manage functional change requests and maintain a record of approved enhancements.
* Monitor ERP adoption, process compliance, and data quality.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting, workflow automation, and operational visibility.

**H. Reporting, MIS and Management Information**

* Configure and validate operational reports, dashboards, and management information reports.
* Support reporting requirements relating to sales, procurement, inventory, production, projects, finance, and HR.

4. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

5. Experience

* Approximately 3–6 years of relevant experience in ERP functional consulting, preferably with Odoo ERP.
* Hands-on experience in Odoo implementation, configuration, business process mapping, testing, and user support.
* Experience in multi-department or multi-company ERP implementations will be preferred.
* Exposure to manufacturing, marine services, trading, supply chain, project operations, or engineering businesses will be an advantage

title: Software Engineer - IICS
description:
**Introduction:**  
Our goal at Pivotree is to help accelerate the future of frictionless commerce. We will help lead this change over the next decade because we believe a future where technology is embedded intimately into all aspects of our everyday lives can benefit everyone and will shape the interactions with the brands we love. We will help shape the future of frictionless commerce by working together with some of the best brands in the world and some of the best people in the industry to leverage converging technologies that will make it possible to accelerate frictionless commerce faster than ever.
  
  
Pivotree provides services focused on the design, implementation, management, and maintenance of complex ecommerce solutions for large enterprises. We provide the technical skills necessary to enable the effective use of technologies combined with the business context to leverage a solution to solve our clients' business challenges. We strive to fill the gaps in available technology with our own IP to reduce the barriers to adoption.
  
  
We enable inclusive, immersive and highly personalized experiences for our clients and their customers. We build our products with a view to productizing and scaling technology to lower the costs and reduce the risks of implementing and managing our integrated solutions. Each of our solutions starts with reliable and reputable e-commerce and MDM platforms, which run on enterprise grade infrastructure that are customized to meet a variety of client needs, situations, and budgets. Over the next 10 years we will add new categories and capabilities that will define frictionless commerce ecosystems.
  
  
This is a journey of technology acceleration combined with consumer readiness and adoption. We are looking for people capable of adapting relentlessly to the rapidly evolving world around us.
  
  
Position Summary
  
As a market leader in product data content solutions, Pivotree helps clients assess, implement, and
  
run best-of-breed applications for Master Data Management (MDM) and Product Information
  
Management (PIM). We are looking for an IICS Developer who will design, build, and support
  
integration pipelines that collect, transform, and manage product and enterprise data across cloud
  
applications, databases, and data platforms. This role uses AI tools as part of day-to-day
  
engineering work, under clear standards for quality, data handling, and review.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  

* Design, develop, and maintain Informatica PowerCenter and Informatica Intelligent Cloud

Services (IICS) solutions that deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise data
  
integration.
  

* Develop and optimize mappings, workflows, reusable transformations, expressions, stored

procedures, and ETL pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and loading data into data
  
warehouses, data lakes, and operational systems.
  

* Build and support complex integration patterns, including incremental and delta loads, Slowly

Changing Dimensions (SCD Types 1 and 2), star schema loads, and large-scale batch and
  
near-real-time processing.
  

* Build and maintain REST and web service integrations, service connectors, business services,

and IICS Application Integration (CAI) processes and process objects for real-time integration
  
with Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, and other on-premises and cloud platforms.
  

* Install and configure add-on connectors and drivers for IICS; build file-watching and file-

transfer scripts (SFTP and similar) for scheduled and event-driven data exchange.
  

* Optimize SQL performance, database connectivity, task scheduling, and cloud-native

deployments on Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, and Google BigQuery, using AI-generated
  
performance recommendations only after validating them against execution plans and load metrics.
  

* Implement data quality checks, governance controls, metadata management, lineage, and

impact analysis to keep enterprise data accurate, compliant, and trusted.
  

* Troubleshoot ETL, integration, and pipeline issues, using AI-assisted root cause analysis to

isolate performance bottlenecks, transformation errors, and data quality anomalies. Validate
  
every AI-suggested fix against logs, sample data, and execution plans before it reaches
  
production.
  

* Use approved AI tools across the development lifecycle to draft and review mapping logic,

SQL, test data, and technical documentation, and to summarize job logs. Follow Pivotree's AI
  
usage policy at all times, including rules on client and customer data, and record where AI
  
contributed to each change.
  

* Contribute to AI-enabled data enrichment use cases, such as attribute extraction,

categorization, and content normalization for PIM, as the project roadmap requires.
  

* Collaborate with data architects, business analysts, and cross-functional teams to design

integration architectures, document reusable patterns and guidelines for enterprise
  
applications, and continuously improve data management processes.
  

* Communicate project status clearly to management and stakeholders.

Technical Skills
  

* IICS Cloud Data Integration (CDI) and Cloud Application Integration (CAI), 3+ years hands-on:

mappings, mapping tasks, task flows, schedules, parameter files, transformations (Expression,
  
Router, Filter, Lookup, Update Strategy, Union, Aggregator, Joiner, Sorter), CAI processes,
  
service connectors, and process objects.
  

* Informatica PowerCenter, 5+ years hands-on: mappings, workflows, reusable transformations,

stored procedures, and session tuning.
  

* Advanced SQL on Oracle and SQL Server: complex joins, analytic functions, query tuning, and

DDL generation; plus Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or Google BigQuery loading and
  
performance tuning (preferred).
  

* REST APIs and web services with JSON and XML payloads, including authentication, error

handling, and integrations with Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, or Workday.
  

* Data warehousing and modeling: star schemas, SCD Types 1 and 2, incremental loads,

conceptual, logical, and physical data models, and data quality and lineage tooling.
  

* File processing and scripting: flat files (CSV, delimited, XML), file-watching and SFTP transfer

scripts, Unix/Linux shell or DOS scripting, Python for validation and API work (preferred), and
  
installing IICS add-on connectors and drivers.
  

* Version control and deployment: Git, IICS asset management, and promotion across

development, test, and production environments.
  

* AI-assisted development: working fluency with an approved AI assistant for SQL, mapping

logic, scripts, and documentation; verifying AI output against sample data and execution plans;
  
keeping client data out of unapproved tools; and building or supporting LLM-based pipeline
  
steps such as enrichment or classification with evaluation and cost monitoring (preferred).
  
  
Key Competencies
  

* Ability to learn new technology quickly and adapt to changes in tooling and platforms.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a systematic approach to root cause analysis.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Commitment to documentation, reusable design patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Ownership of quality: willingness to challenge assumptions, including AI-generated ones,

before they reach production.
  
  
Pivotree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace.

title: Sr. Software Engineer – Sites & Services
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

This senior Individual Contributor (IC) role sits within the Box Tops for Education (BTFE) engineering team, responsible for designing, building, and operating scalable, reliable, and maintainable backend services and APIs that power the BTFE platform. The individual will personally design and develop robust, enterprise-grade solutions built on .NET Core, RESTful APIs, and a microservices architecture, following best practices, coding standards, and sound architectural principles — with no direct reports or formal people-management responsibility. With advanced hands-on expertise across the .NET Core, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL ecosystem, they will execute full lifecycle development — from technical planning and design to implementation, deployment, and ongoing optimization — within an Agile delivery model, working closely with peers, the Delivery Manager, and cross-functional stakeholders. The role also includes direct ownership of production stability, batch job orchestration via Tidal, troubleshooting, and performance tuning to ensure reliability, scalability, and sustained technical excellence across all platforms.

  
  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

Technical Execution & Delivery

* Owning end-to-end design, development, and delivery of complex BTFE platform modules and features, following Agile/Scrum delivery practices

* Applying coding, testing, and design standards for .NET Core, API, and microservices development to ensure scalability, maintainability, and performance

* Providing hands-on production support, including monitoring and troubleshooting of Tidal-scheduled batch jobs, incident response, and root cause analysis for critical issues

* Actively participating in sprint planning, requirement gathering, scope definition, and technical planning alongside the Delivery Manager and team

* Providing reliable technical estimates for assigned work and flagging effort/resourcing risks

* Participating in code and design reviews to ensure technical consistency and best practices

* Contributing to architectural discussions on microservices decomposition and API design, surfacing design gaps and proposing solutions

* Performing performance tuning, query optimization (SQL Server/PostgreSQL), and system-level analysis on owned components

Continuous Learning & Collaboration

* Staying current with emerging technologies and frameworks across the .NET and microservices ecosystem and applying them to own work

* Sharing technical knowledge and informal guidance with peers through code reviews, pairing, and discussions

* Contributing to internal initiatives such as architecture reviews and engineering talks

* Collaborating effectively within the team and supporting a positive, Agile-aligned working culture

Technical Problem-Solving

* Contributing to high-level estimations and technical plans for assigned features and modules

* Designing and building complex, scalable, and secure technical solutions using .NET Core, API, and microservices

* Acting as a subject-matter resource on BTFE's technical implementation when consulted by stakeholders

Contributing hands-on to technology direction and stack decisions within the team, including execution of the SQL Server to PostgreSQL migration  

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Independently plans and manages own workload across complex tasks, contributing input to sprint and project planning in an Agile environment.

* Has personally delivered multiple medium-to-large project components or key enterprise-level features with full accountability for quality and timely delivery.

* Follows and helps refine IT technical standards, consistently applying best practices in own work.

* Possesses expert-level knowledge of enterprise architecture, microservices design patterns, and technical toolsets, applying them to build resilient, scalable solutions.

* Strong hands-on experience with .NET Core and Web API development for building and maintaining enterprise-grade backend services.

* Solid working knowledge of relational databases, including SQL Server and PostgreSQL, with the ability to design schemas, write performant queries, and support database migrations.

* Experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, inter-service communication, and deployment patterns.

* Practical experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery teams, including sprint planning, estimation, and iterative delivery.

* Hands-on experience with Tidal (or similar enterprise job scheduling tools) for designing, monitoring, and troubleshooting batch/scheduled jobs.

* Designs and governs complex third-party integrations, including with SaaS platforms, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and security.

* Shares knowledge and provides technical guidance to peers informally, without formal mentorship or supervisory accountability

* Grows by deepening and sharing technical expertise.

* Delivers impactful, high-quality technical results independently.

Collaborates and aligns effectively with cross-functional partners.  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Preferred: Prior experience on the BTFE (Box Tops for Education) platform or similar education/loyalty rewards platforms.

* Preferred: Experience supporting a SQL Server to PostgreSQL migration.

* Preferred: Advanced experience with enterprise-grade API and microservices platforms, with a track record of delivering scalable backend solutions at scale.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.
